* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...A portion of northeast Illinois, including the following
county, Cook.

rain fell earlier, and flooding of low spots, underpasses,

expected until later this evening.

Chicago, Cicero, Oak Lawn, Midway Airport, Chicago Lawn,
South Lawndale, Englewood, Bridgeport, Roseland, Chicago
Loop, South Shore, Burbank, Homer Glen, Alsip, Palos Hills,
Lemont, Justice, Summit, Burr Ridge and Northerly Island.

drainage areas is imminent or may already be occurring. Persons in
the advisory area should use caution and avoid flood waters.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
